sermons.title: Sermon 635 | Are You Prepared To Die?

scripture.verse: How will you do in the swelling of Jordan?

sermons.title: Sermon 636 | The Church's Love To Her Loving Lord

scripture.verse: Tell me, O You whom my soul loves, where You feed, where You make Your flock to rest at noon: for why should I be as one that turns aside by the flocks of Your companions?

sermons.title: Sermon 637 | The Dove's Return To The Ark

scripture.verse: But the dove found no rest for the soles of her feet and she returned unto him into the ark, for the waters were on the face of the whole earth. Then he put forth his hand and took her and pulled her in unto him into the ark.
And the Lord said, Arise, anoint him, for this is he.

sermons.title: Sermon 640 | The Gospel's Power In a Christian's Life

scripture.verse: Only let your conversation be as it becomes the Gospel of Christ

sermons.title: Sermon 641 | Confession Of Sin Illustrated by the Cases of Dr. Pritchard and Constance Kent

scripture.verse: I acknowledged my sin unto thee, and mine iniquity have I not hid. I said, I will confess my transgressions unto the Lord; and thou forgavest the iniquity of my sin.
He that withholds corn, the people shall curse him but blessing shall be upon the head of him that sells it.
And God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes.
